description: Type the 503 `out_of_capacity` a create or fork gets while Boat has paused new machines. The spec documents it on components.responses.NoReadyMachine, the 503 of POST /sandboxes and POST /sandboxes/{sandboxId}/fork ("`out_of_capacity`: creates and forks are paused until the provisioning queue drains"); it generated as the generic ServiceUnavailable. It stays a retryable server error, as ServiceUnavailable was, because the pause ends when the queue drains. Source: spec-mirror-boat-dev 71ab00f.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Boat has paused creates and forks until its provisioning queue drains. Retry later.
